scope: Four adapter modules only: Zoom, AutoJump, AirJump and HighJump. Other 26 retained core policies are inactive.
The run includes inherited AutoJump/Zoom regression checks and new AirJump/HighJump checks.
Actual leave/rejoin refreshed AirJump activation level from 92 to 80.
The linked client came from official Mixins R5 staging plus pinned Cargo; stock launcher end-to-end build/install remains unverified.
limitations: Sampled heights/velocities are observations, not exact mathematical apex values.
No direct control exposes per-jump needs_sync/exhaustion; saved native jump counters are collected separately when available without client-wrapper attribution.
Continuing horizontal motion and native identity tests do not prove exact statistic/exhaustion counts.
Source AutoJump has no independently invented GUI guard.
Only generated worlds/settings and this process's private control socket are used.
AirJump exercises rebound keyboard J; mouse jump bindings are not exercised.
Per-jump exhaustion, needs_sync and exact wrapper-tail counts remain dynamically unverified.
Mouse jump bindings were not tested; the rebound keyboard J was exercised.
No exact-apex, complete per-module or full Meteor parity claim is made.
